column1: # Intended terms per case, for the natural-accent set.
# One term per line: set, TAB, case id, TAB, term. The term is a string that
# must appear in the recognised text of that case.
# The point of this file is that it does not depend on the reference text of
# the two disputed free-speech cases (S-007, S-008), whose reference was
# transcribed from the Paraformer output. The terms below are the intended
# spellings, so a backend that recognises the word the user actually said is
# credited even when the surrounding reference is wrong.
# words) plus the code and product names used in the read sentences.
